posts.title: Chi-inpainting missing values along stream networks
posts.description: Swarnam recently asked whether it is possible to carve a concave profile across flat areas in DEMs. This is particularly relevant where infilled reservoirs and dams overprint the actual topography, but it may also be helpful where the DEM has large patches of erroneous values.
